meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

howto.what: Claude 能使用 DeepChem 库进行分子性质预测、药物发现和材料设计。它可加载分子数据，转化为特征，训练传统机器学习或图神经网络模型，并利用 MoleculeNet 基准数据集进行评测。
howto.when: 当用户提出分子性质预测（如溶解度、毒性）、药物发现、材料设计，或要求使用 MoleculeNet 数据集、图神经网络时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude uses DeepChem to predict molecular properties (solubility, toxicity, ADMET), perform drug discovery, and design materials. It can load molecular data, featurize molecules, train traditional ML or GNN models, and run MoleculeNet benchmarks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests molecular property prediction, drug discovery, materials design, or asks to use MoleculeNet datasets or graph neural networks.
